title: Entropy-Aware Token Rejection for Improving Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2512.23765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens and a stronger target model to verify them. However, standard SD is mainly designed for acceleration, and its output quality is typically constrained by the target model. In this work, we propose Entropy-Aware Speculative Decoding (EASD), a lightweight and training-free extension of SD that improves reasoning quality through token-level entropy-guided rejection. EASD detects cases where both draft and target models exhibit high uncertainty while strongly overlapping in their top predictions. In such uncertain-agreement cases, EASD rejects the aligned token and resamples from the target distribution, preventing low-confidence errors from propagating. translated_title: 面向提升推测解码的熵感知令牌拒绝方法
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过使用一个轻量级的草稿模型来提出令牌、再由一个更强的目标模型进行验证，从而加速大语言模型的推理。然而，标准的推测解码主要为加速而设计，其输出质量通常受限于目标模型。在本工作中，我们提出了熵感知推测解码，这是一种轻量级、无需训练的推测解码扩展方法，通过令牌级别的熵引导拒绝来提升推理质量。EASD能够检测草稿模型与目标模型同时表现出高不确定性、但其顶级预测高度重合的情况。在这种“不确定但一致”的情况下，EASD会拒绝该对齐的令牌，并从目标分布中重新采样，从而防止低置信度的错误继续传播。在具有挑战性的推理基准上的实验表明，EASD在保持加速效果的同时，相比标准推测解码以及基于奖励引导的变体，始终如一地提升了准确率。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的熵感知推测解码方法EASD，当草稿模型与目标模型同时高度不确定但预测一致时拒绝该令牌并从目标分布重新采样，从而防止低置信度错误传播，在保持加速的同时提升大语言模型的推理准确率。
en_tdlr: EASD is a lightweight, training-free extension of speculative decoding that rejects tokens when both draft and target models are highly uncertain yet agree in their top predictions, resampling from the target distribution to prevent low-confidence error propagation and consistently improve reasoning accuracy while maintaining speedup.
